import.heading: Import a vocabulary
import.lede: Bring in a published vocabulary from an RDF file or a web address. Its classes and properties become available to your fields and item types.
source.formatHelp: Leave this on “Detect automatically” unless the import says it cannot tell the format.
about.namespaceHelp: The web address every class and property of the vocabulary starts with, such as http://xmlns.com/foaf/0.1/. Only the terms under it are imported. It usually ends with / or #.
about.prefixHelp: A short name written before each term, as in foaf:name. Use letters, numbers, hyphens and underscores.
about.label: Label
about.labelHelp: The name people see for this vocabulary.
advanced.langHelp: A language tag such as en or fr. Labels and comments in that language are kept. Without one, or for a term that has none in it, the first in the file is kept.
advanced.label: Label property
advanced.labelHelp: Only for a vocabulary that names its terms with an unusual property. Write the full property URI in angle brackets, such as <http://schema.org/name>. Without one, skos:prefLabel, rdfs:label, foaf:name, rss:title and dc:title are tried in turn.
advanced.commentHelp: The same, for the description of each term. Without one, rdfs:comment is read.
error.noUrl: Enter the web address of the file.
update.toggle: Update from a file or web address
update.lede: Compare this vocabulary with a newer copy of its file. You see every change before anything is saved.
diff.review: Review these changes before you apply them.
diff.none: This vocabulary already matches the file. There is nothing to change.
diff.removedNote: These stay in the archive, and so do the values and item types that use them. Delete one from its own page if you no longer need it.
diff.label: Label
